encounters.label: Escape the ambush
encounters.provenance: Original DRAUTH trap cast and AMOV positions; five opponents and at most three simultaneous attackers corroborated by https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/dreamcast/198621-shenmue/faqs/72404. Shared practice move identities/timing supply presentation. Health, speed, circular hit/separation rules, rectangular arena padding, basic control set and strict restart are authored adaptations, not the original free-battle engine.

encounters.label: Practice with Fuku-san
encounters.provenance: KAKG dialogue's original Ryo/Fuku positions and existing combat moves. The GameSpot 2000 walkthrough describes a spar that ends automatically before Ine-san's letter. Thirty seconds of server-timed, nonlethal practice, shared basic AI/moves and arena padding are adaptations; this result is practiced, never an ambush victory.
